text: Last summer, I finally took a trip I had been planning for months. I spent weeks researching flights, booking hotels, and making a list of must-see sights. When I arrived, everything felt new and exciting. Walking through the markets, I tasted dishes I had never seen before, like spicy noodles and sweet pastries. Although I had learned a few phrases, I still faced language barriers. Once, I tried to ask for directions, but the shopkeeper misunderstood me and gave me tea instead. We both laughed, and it became one of my favorite memories. That trip taught me that even mistakes can turn into wonderful stories.
